excerpt_i18n.en:
Fan Haoqiang is a very humorous person. When we asked him what embodied AI needs to solve in the next decade, he joked that robots might awaken and wipe out humanity, leaving no next decade. This is, of course, a jest, as exploring industry development inevitably involves some sci-fi imagination. In his view, AI should be a lifelong career. After all, he won a gold medal in the International Olympiad in Informatics in his first year of high school and became a genuine AI researcher starting from his second year.  

The name Yuanli Lingji may sound unfamiliar, but its origins are notable—it is an embodied AI company spun off from Megvii. Its founders include co-founders and some of the earliest employees of Megvii. Shortly after its establishment, the company raised nearly 1 billion yuan across two funding rounds.  

Our curiosity about Yuanli Lingji centers on several points: Are they focused on developing models or physical entities? What is their business model? As a new company emerging from Megvii, what advantages do they hold? And how can they stand out in the current competitive landscape?  

Having interacted with countless clients during his time at Megvii, Fan Haoqiang’s understanding of embodied AI carries a strong "Megvii" flavor.  

From the very first day of entrepreneurship, Fan Haoqiang keenly felt the strong demand from clients for embodied AI. However, he regrets that many of these demands cannot yet be met. The capabilities of robots remain extremely limited, while the precision and efficiency requirements of production lines are astonishingly high.  

In the past, Megvii achieved facial recognition accuracy to 11 nines. Now, even the simplest robotic grasping task may have a success rate of less than half.
excerpt_i18n.es: Fan Haoqiang es una persona muy divertida. Cuando le preguntamos qué problemas deberá resolver la inteligencia encarnada en la próxima década, respondió que quizás los robots despierten y acaben con la humanidad, y entonces no habrá próxima década. Por supuesto, esto es una broma; al explorar el desarrollo de la industria, es inevitable hacer algunas especulaciones de ciencia ficción. En su opinión, la IA debería ser una carrera de por vida. Después de todo, ya ganó la medalla de oro en la Olimpiada Internacional de Informática en primer año de bachillerato, y desde segundo año ha sido un verdadero investigador en IA.
